cfg_shift.note: short shifts: each ld loads only its own bits (register cleared after the ld)
more than 16 clocks: the last 16 bits are loaded
bits shifted before rst_n are gone
a second ld without shifting loads 0 (cleared after the first)

debug_bus.y_changes_on: rising edge of the exported bit clock (fs-cycle start; sample on the falling edge, D67/D70)

sequences.note: write A in slot 3 latches at slot 4 (pair 2, invalid); write B in slot 4 (after the edge) latches at slot 6 (pair 3, invalid); slot 5 still runs config A.
frame of slot 3 is dropped on the link: frame_ctr jumps 2 -> 4; pair 1 is incomplete and must be discarded, pairs 0, 2, 3 demodulate.

short written mid-slot 2 (first slot of pair 1): pair 1 (slots 2,3) is unchanged and valid, the short applies from slot 4 (pair 2, invalid, u forced to 0). Written back to 0 in slot 7: applies from slot 8 (invalid).
three writes in slot 1: the last (x3, fs_div 1) wins and latches at slot 2 (invalid pair 1). A write in slot 2 at offset 0 (y, fs_div 2) is on the edge or later: it latches at slot 4.
write A at the last cycle of slot 3 (before the slot-4 edge) latches at slot 4; write B at offset 0 of slot 4 (on the edge) latches at slot 6, so A runs in pair 2.
262 slots (131 pairs) at N 64, constant u: frame_ctr wraps 255 -> 0 at slot 256; the two ybits (s = +1, -1) are reused by every frame.

boost written in slot 0 latches at slot 2 (pair 1, invalid), never mid-pair (slot 1 still boost 0); the same value again in slot 3 is not a change; trim 6 then trim 2 written in slots 4, 5 (last wins) latch at slot 6 (pair 3, invalid); boost 0 written at the last cycle of slot 6 latches at slot 8 (pair 4, invalid). Slot 3 is not read: slot 4 loads with overrun, status [12:9] follows the hold-register frame.

rd edge before / on / after the load clk (D66 AMB-02/06/10); hold[t].rd_rel is the plan. Slot 0 after: acked. Slot 1 before: no-op, frame 1 stays ready. Slot 2 on: frame 1 is lost (overrun), the rd is suppressed, frame 2 stays ready + overrun. Slot 3 before: clears, then load: ready, no overrun. Slot 4 on: frame 3 lost, rd suppressed. Slot 5 no rd: frame 4 lost. Slot 6 after: frame 5 lost, then cleared. Slots 7-9 after. cfg_pending (post-latch, no mask) at the loads of slots 1..5 = 0, 1, 0, 1, 0: the loads of slots 1 and 3 coincide with a latch (shadow == active after it), so they show 0 although a write was pending before the edge.

active fs_div 1. Writes of fs_div 5 (slot 0), reserved bits 15:13 = 111 (slot 2) and fs_div 6 (slot 4) are not changes: pairs 1 and 2 stay valid, cfg_pending 0. fs_div 0 written in slot 5 is a real change: latches at slot 6, pair 3 invalid. In slots 6 and 7 fs_div 2 and then fs_div 7 are written (last wins): 7 is 1, a change against the active 0, so cfg_pending is 1 at the end of slot 6 and the pair 4 (slots 8, 9) is invalid.

status_layout.13: cfg_pending (v3.1: post-latch value after the load edge in hold[t].status_full; legacy status_word keeps 0)

traces.note: N 64, sys + ota chop, pairs 0 and 1, write (order 1) in slot 2 latching at slot 4, then pair 2. Control trace per fs cycle, 66 cycles per slot.
